avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 6 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Independence Lake (8,340 ft) 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Independence Lake
evidence.detail: left June 8; earlier seasons: July 21 (2023), June 25 (2024), June 30 (2025)

facts.text: At Independence Lake (8,340 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 22.8 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Independence Lake
evidence.detail: 22.8 in on April 23; earlier seasons: 78.8 in (2023), 44.0 in (2024), 49.6 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 12 and June 15, carried from the melt-out date at Independence Lake (8,340 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Independence Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 8, 1,424 ft above the pass; points to April 12 to June 15
